puzzleText: Secret agents use passphrases (also called shibboleths) to recognise one-another in the field. A secret passphrase has a "challenge" and a "response". Some fictional examples from the James Bond film series are: 'From Russia with Love' - when Bond meets Kerim Bey's driver at the airport: "Excuse me, can I borrow a match? I use a lighter. Better still. Until they go wrong." 'You Only Live Twice' - when Bond meets Aki at the Sumo wrestling match: "I love you. I have a car nearby." 'The Spy Who Loved Me' - when Bond meets Sheikh Hosein in the desert: "May the peace of Allah descend upon this magnificent abode and allow a poor traveller to enter. And may the hospitality of this miserable quarters be sufficient to your honored needs." 'For Your Eyes Only' - when Bond meets Luigi Ferrara: "The snow this year is better at Innsbruck. But not at St. Moritz." 'Octopussy' - when Bond meets Vijay Amritraj at the Udaipur docks in India, Vijay - who is charming a snake - changes his tune to the 007 theme song: "Its a charming tune, you do take English money? Only gold sovereigns." 'A View To A Kill' - when Bond meets Chuck Lee: "Looking for something special? Yes, softshell crabs." 'Goldeneye' - when Bond meets CIA agent Jack Wade: "In London April's a Spring month. Whereas in St. Petersberg we're freezing our butts off." ------------------------------- Your Chief has prepared a new secret passphrase for all agents in Cyber Division to use in the field. To help you memorise it, he has made it into a crossword. Solve the crossword with these clues to learn the passphrase. ACROSS 1. NAY THUG rearranged for misbehaviour, twas all for nill-y (7) 4. Forbidden fruit bonks Isaac's noggin (5) 6. TUB backwards bum (3) 7. WIND BLOWS without zebub against framed panes of glass (7) 9. Falls off bike - see? rashes (7) DOWN 2. Crooks are cooks in digital kitchens - cutters, choppers, cleavers (7) 3. Oi, can youse operate it? (3) 5. STOP PAL scrambled for portable computers (7) 8. LA SWAY mixed forevermore (6) -------------------------------
correctAnswer: NAUGHTY HACKERS USE APPLE LAPTOPS BUT WINDOWS ALWAYS CRASHES
hint: Fill in the crossword carefully to reveal the passphrase.
title: Cryptic Crossword Shibboleth
